lines.trans: Someone posted photos online claiming they were taken by a wealthy tycoon.
That goes way too far, though.
What tycoon could put up with her temper? People probably think she is chasing publicity.
Any more publicity like that and her career would be ruined.
If this had broken while she was taping last week, that episode would have been explosive.
On Entertainment Talk she spoke at length about her charity foundation.
Once the episode airs in the next couple of days, it will look like an instant humiliation.
Still, we cannot just cancel the broadcast!
If you cut her segment out, are you not afraid her fans will hound our entire PR department?
Even if they come after someone, they will come after our Production Unit One.
